status: PILOT, not a certified finite-N approximation
stage_order: preflight: 2 paths each at N=100 and N=1000
main: 64 paths each at N=100 and N=1000
N10000_gate: both N1000 preflight paths clear; maximum event count <= 2000000 and maximum kernel runtime <= 0.5 seconds
preflight_analysis: All pilot paths are retained; preflight and main summaries kept separate. Main sample counts fixed irrespective of outcome; gate-selected N10000 explicitly exploratory.
validation: all 4^5 small integer states plus 200 deterministic random states; Python literal reactant/product rates; 3 shared-uniform 5000-event traces at N=10,100,1000; per-event population and nonnegativity checks; explicit horizon case
ODE: ordinary deterministic mass-action A^2, never stochastic falling factorial; SciPy BDF and Radau event integration at rtol1e-9 atol1e-11, tighter BDF1e-11/1e-13 cross-check; analytic Jacobian; horizon200
accuracy_limits: empirical pilot only; report Monte Carlo uncertainty separately from unproved model error; IEEE floating point SSA algorithm, not random-bit/roundoff-certified sampling
cost: charge compilation, validation, process startup, every SSA attempt, all ODE trials and analysis execution; per-process GNU time peak RSS and CPU; log failed trials
